facts.title: Rosemary Gin Fizz
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a small drinking glass, muddle the fresh rosemary, lemon juice and honey.
Fill the glass with ice, then pour in the gin and top with club soda.
Give it a little swirl with a spoon. That’s it!

notes: September 2024: I revised the recipe to increase the honey from ½ teaspoon to 1 teaspoon for more balanced flavor.
facts.summary: This sparkly little drink only takes a few minutes to make. This recipe yields 1 cocktail.
